text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The other day, I was going over schedules with Gold City's manager, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City's schedule lately is beyond being packed by the minute.
Her own body is likely reaching its limit...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Trainer, I overslept!!
The machine reservation time has passed, but is it still good!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—Looks like I didn't make it in time.
The schedule is completely full, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Because of me,
I ended up wasting your time too."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm the one who failed to deliver. I'm the one who decided to balance work and racing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Then what's the point if I can't even manage my own condition?
Get a grip on your exhaustion, me...!
choice_data_list: Blaming yourself like that will only wear you out more.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Plus, since you got to rest this morning, you can give it your all in practice!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Right now, wasting time
regretting it would be even worse.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, switched gears. Trainer,
let's find something we can work on right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we looked for an open training facilityand somehow managed to secure one.
